page: Microsoft Azure NV12s_v2 is an x86_64 architecture server belonging to the NVSv2 family, virtualized via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 12 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor, paired with 224.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 18.67 GB per vCPU. The hardware configuration includes a single GPU and 1509 GB of local SSD storage.

This server is Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-throughput persistent storage options alongside its local solid-state disk. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The system is designed for workloads requiring a combination of dedicated CPU resources, substantial memory capacity, and local solid-state storage.

Given the inclusion of a dedicated GPU, 12 dedicated vCPUs, and 224.0 GB of RAM, the NV12s_v2 is configured for memory-intensive and GPU-accelerated tasks. This resource density makes it suitable for database hosting, specialized visualization, and workloads requiring significant memory overhead per core. The qualitative cost efficiency is defined by its high memory-to-vCPU ratio and bundled GPU, positioning it as a specialized resource-dense instance.
